Summary

Bachelor of Business Information Technology graduate from Kabarak University, with strong interest and practical experience in software development, backend systems, mobile apps, data analytics and enterprise transaction monitoring. 

Skilled in building REST and GraphQL APIs, managing SQL and PostgreSQL databases, and setting up containerised environments and data pipelines using PHP, Java (Spring Boot), Python, C/C++, Flutter, React, and Next.js. 

Combines hands-on application development with system integration, risk analysis, and secure coding practices.Combines technical skills in application development with system integration, risk analysis, and secure coding practices.

Scoped, built, and am currently testing a full-scale school management system for Kingsway Preparatory School (Londiani), covering student records, attendance, fee structures, and parent portals.
Built full-stack student software projects and provided technical consultations to help students design, debug, and complete their systems, alongside planning and building personal apps such as MboQara and a BMI Calculator.
Developed backend services, REST APIs, and interactive monitoring dashboards using Python, Java Spring Boot, and Node.js with secure coding, business logic, and data validation controls.
Designed, maintained, and optimised PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases for auditability, high data integrity, and fast reporting performance.
Configured containerised environments using Docker and automated CI/CD pipelines via GitHub, using technical documentation and modern developer tools to speed up debugging and root-cause troubleshooting.

Collaborated across technical teams and stakeholders to manage issue resolution, access control, and project timelines.

Monitored daily card and digital transactions using Visa Risk Manager (VRM) and TranzWare, troubleshooting anomalies and resolving incidents.
Analyzed transaction data in Microsoft Excel and SQL to detect high-risk patterns across local and cross-border channels.
Drafted technical summaries and incident reports for flagged transactions to support audit trails and operational compliance.
Collaborated with cross-functional IT, settlements, and reconciliation teams to resolve system issues and maintain application reliability.
Worked with enterprise application monitoring, secure banking networks, and production support controls.
